t.zh: 证出的引理本身就是一条规则：<part-ref to="lemma:chain"></part-ref>是 ⟦?A → ?B; ?B → ?C⟧ ⟹ ?A → ?C。它和证明核的规则一样能倒着用，元件上都能选到。
t.en: A lemma you proved is itself a rule: <part-ref to="lemma:chain"></part-ref> is ⟦?A → ?B; ?B → ?C⟧ ⟹ ?A → ?C. It can be used backwards just like the kernel’s rules, and the part offers it too.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，用<part-ref to="lemma:chain"></part-ref>证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal with <part-ref to="lemma:chain"></part-ref>.

hint.zh: 目标里读不出<part-ref to="lemma:chain"></part-ref>的中间那一句。
hint.en: The middle sentence of <part-ref to="lemma:chain"></part-ref> cannot be read off the goal.

brief.zh: 再用<part-ref to="lemma:swap"></part-ref>证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Now prove every goal with <part-ref to="lemma:swap"></part-ref>.

brief.zh: 再用<part-ref to="lemma:merge"></part-ref>证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Now prove every goal with <part-ref to="lemma:merge"></part-ref>.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="lemma:merge"></part-ref>的结论对上目标以后，还剩什么要证？
hint.en: Once <part-ref to="lemma:merge"></part-ref>’s conclusion fits the goal, what is left to prove?
